subject: CS231
filterSummary: Selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering key difficult topics in digital logic circuits. The English selections heavily feature Neso Academy and ALL ABOUT ELECTRONICS for their clear, high-quality explanations. The Arabic selections draw from a mix of academic lecturers and specialized channels like Walid Issa, providing comprehensive coverage. All selections directly address the specified student difficulties, such as using excitation tables, understanding propagation delay, and correct parallel load design.
